findings.desc: CHK-001:adversarial:1 claims evidence proves "Peer with parallelSafe=no has overlapping path -> no overlap_declared_parallel block (peer must also assert parallel)," but the smoke block 8 (line 142-151 of parallel-decomposition-gate-smoke.ts) tests the CONVERSE scenario: story parallelSafe=no with a parallel peer. No smoke fixture exercises story=parallel + peer=non-parallel + overlapping paths. The gate code at line 73 does implement this correctly (assertsParallel(peer) check), but the smoke evidence does not directly assert the stated claim. CHK-002:edge:4 claims the same scenario is covered by the smoke, compounding the mismatch.

CHK-001:adversarial:2 claims evidence proves "Story own contract missing from Map -> fail-open (block=null, NOT peer_contract_unreadable)." No smoke block omits the story S from the contracts Map. Every fixture in parallel-decomposition-gate-smoke.ts (blocks 1-10) passes a contract for story S. The gate implementation at lines 62-63 handles this correctly (sContract check, sWriteSet defaults to []), but the stated behavioral claim is never exercised by the smoke. The evidence command node packages/main/dist/tasks/parallel-decomposition-gate-smoke.js does not cover this intent.
